entry.title: Resolution 595 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE, NATURAL RESOURCES CONSERVATION SERVICE, FOR COST SHARING TO PURCHASE A CONSERVATION EASEMENT FOR THE KEALOHA FAMILY LOʻI IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEYS: 5-2-009:025 AND 5-2-009:026 THROUGH THE PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION PROGRAM

Allows for the receipt of federally-derived matching funds for the acquisition of the Kealoha Family Lo‘i conservation easement authorized by

Status: — → Adopted
